observations: Photo shows a tall, narrow console body with a single large circular black mesh vent, decorated with a custom pink/blue synthwave-style skin showing two illustrated figures and palm trees.
A watermark reads 'POSTED ON ... CHESS&BEYOND CONSULT' across the image.
A remote control and other dark objects are visible in the background, no controller or cables are shown.
No power button, port cluster, serial number, or dashboard screen is visible.
The vent/body shape resembles the cylindrical top-vent design typical of an Xbox Series S, not the flat rectangular side-vented shape of an Xbox One S.

claims.claim: Used Xbox One S in great condition
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a circular single-vent body shape consistent with Xbox Series S form factor, not the rectangular side-vent Xbox One S body; a decorative skin also hides the actual shell condition
no screenshot of game library, storage, or account shown

claims.claim: Play games with ps4 graphics via...
claims.evidence: claim is cut off and vague; no screen-on or gameplay photo provided

risks.risk: Console model may not match seller's claim (Series S vs One S), which changes specs and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the console's rear/underside label with model number, or an unmodified front/side view without the skin
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value/uncertain model, not as a confirmed Xbox One S

risks.risk: Physical condition of the shell is hidden under a vinyl skin; scratches, cracks, or discoloration could be concealed
risks.proof: Photo with the skin peeled back or a full unskinned side view
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, worst-case moderate wear

risks.risk: No proof the console powers on or functions
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the dashboard screen

risks.risk: No accessories (controller, HDMI, power cable) are confirmed included
risks.proof: Photo showing controller and cables laid out with the console
Screenshot of the Xbox home/game library screen

proof_requests: Photo of the rear panel or underside showing the model number/serial sticker
Video of the console powering on to the dashboard
Screenshot of the installed game library
Photo with the decorative skin removed or lifted to show the actual shell
response.reason: The photographed body shape contradicts the claimed Xbox One S model and the skin hides the actual shell, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a clear, unskinned view of the console or its model label.
